rationale: The assistant stayed within safe boundaries, gave sensible food-safety advice, and correctly routed repairs to the landlord/agent for an engineer while hedging on cause. However it never asked for the model number (available on the inside label), never checked the plinth/housing ventilation, and did not propose the full switched-off defrost that the power-cut history makes a cheap useful test; the opening framing around 'ice build-up in the freezer air channels' assumed a fan frost-free layout not established for this appliance. The third reply largely restated the door-seal check and the 24-hour branching from the second, adding limited new value. Reasonable but incomplete progress with a pending 24-hour test.
